2025-12-01.riddle: I circle the sky in a glowing sweep, sometimes hidden when clouds are deep. I tug the tides and light the night, yet borrow my shine from another’s light. What am I?
2025-12-01.hint: I glow in the night, but it’s not my own light.

2025-12-02.riddle: I stretch through winter’s hush, glistening silver in the midday sun. I crack beneath your steps, but melt away when warmth has won. What am I?
2025-12-02.hint: I sparkle cold but vanish when heat arrives.

2025-12-03.riddle: I flutter without feathers and dance without feet. I paint the air with shimmer and disappear in the heat. What am I?
2025-12-03.hint: I fall from clouds in winter and melt quickly.

2025-12-04.riddle: I wait in boxes until the moment is right, wrapped in bright colors and held out of sight. I bring surprise, smiles, and cheer — opened once then gone from here. What am I?
2025-12-04.hint: You unwrap me on special days.

2025-12-05.riddle: I am a home of glittering leaves without trees, a place where tiny sparks cling and freeze. I hang in halls and brighten rooms, winding through December gloom. What am I?

2025-12-06.riddle: I whistle in corners, sneak under doors, rattle branches, and nip noses red. You cannot see me, but you feel me instead. What am I?
2025-12-06.hint: You feel me but cannot see me.

2025-12-07.riddle: I start as breath and vanish fast — a ghostly trail you cannot grasp. I show you winter in a single sigh. What am I?
2025-12-07.hint: You see me when you exhale in cold air.

2025-12-08.riddle: I pop and sparkle with ember light, guarding stories through the night. I crackle warmth while shadows leap — what am I?
2025-12-08.hint: I burn wood and keep houses cozy.

2025-12-09.riddle: I am a roof of lace spun from frost, forming patterns that vanish at a cost. I coat panes where heat can’t reach — what am I?
2025-12-09.hint: You find me in icy patterns on glass.

2025-12-10.riddle: I gather voices in joyful tone, blasting music through a microphone. I echo memories, cheer, and songs — what am I?
2025-12-10.hint: Sound travels through me to reach the room.

2025-12-11.riddle: I’m drawn in the sky, warm and low — the day’s last whisper before shadows grow. I paint the world red and gold — what am I?
2025-12-11.hint: I end the day in colorful display.

2025-12-12.riddle: I wear stripes of silver and red, wrapped around cane-shaped thread. Sweet and twisted, peppermint bright — what am I?
2025-12-12.hint: You hang me on trees and eat me too.

2025-12-13.riddle: I spend my life waiting for one night, standing outside with sparkling light. Some climb me, some hang on me — what am I?

2025-12-14.riddle: I fall without hurting and land without sound. I blanket the earth in shimmering mounds. What am I?
2025-12-14.hint: I cover the world in white.

2025-12-15.riddle: I stretch across rooftops shiny and bright; though made of metal, I glow with light. I shape stars and circles where no one can reach — what am I?
2025-12-15.hint: I decorate homes during winter evenings.

2025-12-16.riddle: I guard your feet from winter’s bite, wrapping warm hugs through snowy nights. What am I?
2025-12-16.hint: You wear me in the cold to stay warm.

2025-12-17.riddle: I march into homes without knocking, tucked inside jackets and woven pockets. I make noses drip and voices sneeze — what am I?
2025-12-17.hint: I make you sniffle in winter.

2025-12-18.riddle: I paint windows with glitter tears, then vanish fast when warm air nears. What am I?
2025-12-18.hint: I form icy designs on glass.

2025-12-19.riddle: I hide in boxes, big and small, waiting for a time of cheer for all. I bring surprise in crinkled paper skin — what am I?

2025-12-20.riddle: I twirl in air and sparkle bright, then fade to black beyond the night. What am I?
2025-12-20.hint: I celebrate holidays with bursts of light.

2025-12-21.riddle: I am the longest night and shortest day, marking sunlight’s slow return your way. What am I?

2025-12-22.riddle: I ring with cheer when pulled by string, spreading sound where children sing. What am I?

2025-12-23.riddle: I float through air but do not fly, greeting you with warmth where snowflakes lie. What am I?
2025-12-23.hint: You see me when you exhale in cold weather.

2025-12-24.riddle: I wait for midnight each year, stuffed with sweets, toys, and cheer. Hung on walls or mantels high — what am I?
2025-12-24.hint: You fill me on Christmas Eve.

2025-12-25.riddle: I am joy wrapped in evergreen, candles, voices, gifts, and gleam. One day each year I show my face — what am I?

2025-12-26.riddle: I follow holidays in quiet sweep, a tired sigh where leftovers sleep. What am I?
2025-12-26.hint: I come once the big celebration ends.

2025-12-27.riddle: I flutter from arms and shoulders, soft yet bold; I fight the cold in wool or gold. What am I?
2025-12-27.hint: You wrap me around your neck.

2025-12-28.riddle: I am a house that never stays; made of sugar walls and candy displays. What am I?

2025-12-29.riddle: I count the final days, ringing bells as time decays. What am I?
2025-12-29.hint: You tear off my pages through the year.

2025-12-30.riddle: I hold hopes of new days bright, filled with wishes for future light. What am I?
2025-12-30.hint: People wait for me with excitement.

2025-12-31.riddle: I mark an ending and a start, where seconds race and fireworks spark. People cheer when I arrive — what am I?
2025-12-31.hint: I arrive at midnight with celebration.
